isAutoLine.label: Is Auto Line (Automated Station)
isAutoLine.desc: Marks machine as automated line. Enables Group, Step link & 3-phase flow.

isSfcPreCheck.label: Is SFC PreCheck (PreCheck with SFC)
isSfcPreCheck.desc: Enables PreCheck verification with SFC (MES) before product enters station.

isSfcStation.label: Is SFC Station (Insert Result Station)
isSfcStation.desc: Marks station to post results to SFC (MES). Aggregates KeyParts (IsSFC=1).

sendSfcOnPassOnly.label: Send SFC On Pass Only
sendSfcOnPassOnly.desc: Only sends data to SFC when Client result is PASS. Other results kept locally.

allowFailPassThrough.label: Allow Fail Pass-Through
allowFailPassThrough.desc: Allows product to pass through when measurement is FAIL without line bottleneck.

explanation.title: Meaning & Operational Logic of Machine Flags:
explanation.item1: Marks machine as part of automated line. Enables Group, Step linking and manages 3-phase internal inspection flow (PreCheck → Link → Undo).
explanation.item2: Enables PreCheck verification handshake with SFC (MES) before carrier enters station.
explanation.item3: Marks station to submit test results (Insert Result) to SFC (MES). Automatically aggregates SFC KeyParts (IsSFC = 1).
explanation.item4: Only communicates with SFC when Client result is PASS. Other results saved locally in AutoLine.
explanation.item5: Allows product to continue down the line even when FAIL to prevent bottleneck.

validationKeys.expTitle: Definition & Operational Logic of Keypart Flags
validationKeys.expIsRequire: Key must be scanned and transmitted, cannot be empty or N/A. Completeness is checked regardless of IsBypass flag.
validationKeys.expIsBypass: Bypasses duplicate check (Check 2) and upstream station cross-check (Check 3). If IsBypass=1 and IsRequire=1, value is still required.
validationKeys.expIsVerify: Must strictly match the value scanned at the preceding station within the same cycle.
validationKeys.expIsSfc: Marks key as SFC required key. The system aggregates all SFC keys to post to SFC Station.

screwConfig.tableSubtitle: Applied to AutoLine automated screwdriving station

screwConfig.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete screw position "{{pos}}"?
screwConfig.expTitle: AutoLine Screw Data Validation & Tolerance Mechanisms
screwConfig.rule1Desc: Direct cross-check of 4 pairs (Torque, Angle, Volume, Height) against [Standard ± Limit]. Any violation forces error 426 (SCREW FAIL).
screwConfig.rule2Desc: If Required = Yes and station omits position, automatically flags MISSING_SCREW_POSITION and fails transaction.
screwConfig.rule3Desc: When screwdriving station sends new position for first time, system auto-registers with 0 (unmonitored) to avoid line stoppages.
screwConfig.rule4Desc: Can toggle Active = Bypass during maintenance or trial runs to bypass checks without deleting configuration.

pressfitConfig.expTitle: AutoLine Pressfit Data Validation & Tolerance Mechanisms
pressfitConfig.rule1Desc: Direct cross-check of 3 technical specs (Force, Time, Distance) against [Standard ± Limit]. Any violation forces error 428 (PRESSFIT FAIL).
pressfitConfig.rule2Desc: If Required = Yes and station omits position, automatically flags MISSING_PRESSFIT_POSITION and fails transaction.
pressfitConfig.rule3Desc: When press machine sends new position first time (ST05), system auto-registers with 0 (unmonitored) to avoid line stoppages.
pressfitConfig.rule4Desc: Can toggle Active = Bypass during maintenance or trial runs to bypass checks without deleting configuration.
